results.title: Trey Mancini officially retires ahead of Orioles ceremony
results.description: (Photo credit: Tommy Gilligan) Trey Mancini, who played six of his eight major league seasons with the Baltimore Orioles, officially retired Saturday after signing a one-day contract with his former club. Mancini, 34, was set to be celebrated for his inspiring career before the Orioles' home game Saturday against the Milwaukee Brewers. results.title: Steelers WR Michael Pittman (foot) out vs. Patriots
results.description: (Photo credit: Barry Reeger) The Pittsburgh Steelers downgraded wide receiver Michael Pittman from questionable to out for Sunday's game against the New England Patriots in Foxborough, Mass. Pittman was limited in practice on Wednesday and did not participate the next two days due to a foot injury. He had three catches for 58 yards in Pittsburgh's 20-13 victory over the Atlanta Falcons last Sunday.
